name: the rate-this-app dialog over Settings

regions_read.verdict_on_region: names the section behind the dialog; still legible through the dim

regions_read.text: Thank you for using  PDF Reader, PDF Viewer! We would be very grateful if you could rate us.
regions_read.verdict_on_region: unconventional position (lower half); a thank-you addressed by the app's name -- names content, not a place; dismissed

identifier_found: "Settings" -- the title of the screen behind the dialog, legible through the dim
initial_rationale: the dialog's own heading is a thank-you, but the Settings title stays readable above it

test_cases.action: tap Rate App (without touching the stars), read the dialog heading and the screen behind it, then press Back
test_cases.expected_result: the dialog heading names a place or only thanks the user; the Settings title is or is not legible behind
test_cases.overturns_if: the Settings title is not legible behind the dialog
test_cases.observed_result: the dialog read "Thank you for using PDF Reader, PDF Viewer!" -- a thank-you by app name, not a place; "Settings" and the back arrow stayed legible through the dim above it; the dialog has no close control but Back returned to Settings

deciding_evidence: "Settings" remains legible behind the dialog, and the dialog is plainly a rating prompt from its stars and "Rate this App"; the dialog's heading itself is dismissed as content. The dialog draws no close control -- only Back leaves it
